run_sync_watcher: run the sync_watcher script to monitor sys_sync kernel calls and print timing data
create_sync_call_structure: create a SyncCall ctypes Structure with comm, time, and pid fields for BPF events
probe_sys_sync_entry: probe the sys_sync kernel function entry to record start times per process PID
probe_sys_sync_exit: probe the sys_sync kernel function exit to calculate duration and output timing events
create_bpf_queue_and_map: create a BpfQueue for SyncCall events and a BPF map to track sync start times
